remarks: Welcome to 33 N Water Street #506 - a bright and spacious 1-bedroom waterfront condo for rent in Norwalk, CT, located in the highly desirable SoNo (South Norwalk) neighborhood.  This well-maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit features an open-concept floor plan with abundant natural light and beautiful water views. The living and dining area offers flexible space for both relaxing and entertaining, while the kitchen provides ample cabinet storage and counter space. The oversized bedroom includes two generous closet spaces, and the full bathroom is clean and updated. One of the most valuable features of this rental is private and secure off-street parking, a rare find in South Norwalk. Additional building amenities include secure entry, elevator access, fitness center, and professionally maintained common areas.  Enjoy true waterfront living in Norwalk just steps from marinas, scenic harbor walks, restaurants, cafes, nightlife, boutique shopping, and the SoNo Collection. Ideal for commuters, the location offers quick access to Metro-North, I-95, Route 7, and nearby Stamford and Westport.
